Remove the gray guide's baked shading. No background, floor, text or labels. Any glowing parts must be painted their glowing colour without casting light onto surroundings.
This is a precisely registered orthographic texture projection, not a redesigned object or beauty render.
Requested view: LEFT. The guide shows the tarp-awning side: rear rim at image left, rounded nose at image right, chimney above the left-middle. Keep every support, ragged tarp edge, base block and cable exactly in the guide's location.
